last_review.summary: The change meets AUTH-017-A’s acceptance criteria and complies with the architecture. HumanAuthGuard retains HTTP Bearer extraction and request attachment while delegating authentication to the new channel-neutral HumanAuthenticationService. The service deterministically rejects nok_test_/nok_live_ credentials before invoking the human verifier, uses the existing HUMAN_IDENTITY_VERIFIER and HumanPrincipalResolver pipeline, returns the established Principal shape, and is provided/exported by IdentityModule. Changes are confined to src/identity/, introduce no MCP/OAuth/Core/database behavior, and deterministic build and Prisma validation both passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
